text_zh: 圣器渴饮铅屑，每饮一滴，引擎之门槛愈高。祝圣必成，代价亦重。
text_en: The relic thirsts for lead shavings. Each drop drunk, the Engine's threshold rises. Consecration assured, but at mounting cost.

text_zh:
档案编号: S-████
版级: 熔版 / Fusum
收容记录: 第██层深处发现

描述: 铭文组呈深褐色，表面有疑似血迹渗透痕迹。持有者报告祝圣仪式'从未失败'，但每次仪式后收容基准显著上升。D-████使用后失联前最后传讯：'它在要求更多。我听见了饥饿的声音。'

备注: 已记录████次使用。无一失败案例。██名持有者失联率100%。
text_en:
Archive ID: S-████
Gradus: Fusum / Molten
Recovery: Deep ██th Layer

Description: Inscription exhibits deep brown coloration with suspected hemoglobin infiltration. Holders report consecration rites 'never fail', though containment thresholds escalate significantly per ritual. D-████'s final transmission before loss of contact: 'It's demanding more. I can hear the hunger.'

Note: ████ recorded uses. Zero failure cases. 100% holder attrition rate.
